      <title>California’s coastal communities on alert as biggest waves in years hit state</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/20/california-coastal-communities-alert-big-waves-hit-state</link>
      <description><p>Hazard warnings issued throughout week after powerful swells and waves of more than 9 metres recorded</p><p>Multiple coastal hazard warnings were issued this week across California as successive areas of low pressure generated powerful swells and large breaking waves for coastal communities. Beaches and piers were closed last weekend as large waves crashed into California’s coastline. Offshore National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration buoys recorded wave heights of greater than 30ft (9 metres) last Friday. The Monterey, California, buoy recorded a wave height of 34.1ft, which would make it the highest reading in 30 years.</p><p>Coastal warnings extended from last weekend through this week, with alerts extending until Friday night. Waves of 10-18ft are expected, with local sets of 18-22ft for San Luis Obispo county beaches and Santa Barbara county central coast beaches. These Pacific storm systems are also bringing unsettled conditions across the western US, with heavy rain, mountain snow, and strong winds through the coming days. Already, record-breaking rainfall affected San Fransisco on Wednesday, with heavy rain also causing 32,000 customers to lose power in Sacramento. Into this weekend, a further area of low pressure will bring considerable amounts of moisture for southern Oregon and northern California. By Sunday night, more than 100mm (4in) of rain is expected in places, with further snowfall for areas such as Donner Pass across the northern Sierra Nevada mountains.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/20/california-coastal-communities-alert-big-waves-hit-state">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/nov/19/baobab-five-trees-south-africa-dug-up-export-blocked-georgia-aoe</link>
      <description><p>The trees, intended for an unnamed buyer in Georgia, were reportedly dug up without the necessary permits</p><p>Environmentalists in South Africa are racing to replant five centuries-old baobabs after the 20-tonne trees were dug up by an exporter, who tried to ship them thousands of miles to Georgia.</p><p>The baobabs arrived at a reserve in Timbavati, in north-eastern South Africa, on Wednesday, where they will be replanted and supported by cables to help them recover. The trees had been stranded at a warehouse in Durban since July, when they were intercepted by authorities who said they had been moved without the necessary permissions.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/nov/19/baobab-five-trees-south-africa-dug-up-export-blocked-georgia-aoe">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2026/nov/19/women-girls-rights-rape-sexual-violence-africa-marriage-unfpa</link>
      <description><p>Almost half of women in west and central Africa cannot withhold consent, with girls worst affected, UNFPA finds</p><p>One in four women around the world have no power of consent if their husband or partner demands sex, according to a UN report.</p><p>In west and central Africa, almost half of women (45%) are not able to say no in their own marriage, while a third of women (33%) in east and southern Africa and in Arab states face the same predicament.       <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/20/race-to-be-next-un-secretary-general-exposes-divisions-among-world-powers</link>
      <description><p>Debate about dominance of permanent five members could reignite if major powers block Costa Rican frontrunner</p><p>The race to become the next UN secretary general could reach a decisive moment on Friday when a UN security council vote is likely to reveal whether the Costa Rican frontrunner for the post would be blocked by the big powers. If so, the setback will reignite a debate about the dominance of the permanent five (P5) members at the United Nations.</p><p>Rebeca Grynspan, an economist and UN insider who is from a family of Polish-Jewish wartime refugees to Costa Rica, has been in the lead in all but one of the eight straw polls of the 15 UN security council members since the first secret ballot was held on 30 July. Each member goes down the list of candidates, casting an “encourage”, “discourage” or “no opinion” vote for each candidate.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/20/race-to-be-next-un-secretary-general-exposes-divisions-among-world-powers">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>EU wants ‘closest possible relationship’ with UK after agreeing Brexit reset deal – live</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/20/uk-eu-european-union-brexit-deal-andy-burnham-latest-news-updates</link>
      <description><p>President of European Council says EU ‘remains open to have the closest possible relationship’ with the UK</p><p><em>Senior correspondent</em>
 <br>
 <br>
 <strong>Making today’s reset deal contingent on a further agreement on the level of tuition fees for EU citizens is designed to neutralise the leverage London gets in the next six months, EU sources have said.</strong>
 <br>
 <br>
 Senior diplomats had already confirmed this week that <strong>the EU would defer the deal on the level of tuition fees for another six months</strong>, a move designed to give the UK leverage in parallel negotiations to have the UK included in Made in Europe legislation designed to protect EU supply chains against China.
 <br>
 <br>
 But the move to make the food and drink deal also contingent on a tuition fees deal effectively seeks to neutralise the leverage the UK gets today.
 <br>
 <br>
 <strong>This is a serious chess game</strong> and shows the EU, again, is willing to speak very warmly about the UK but will play absolute hard ball when it comes to conceding any points to a former member state.
 <br>
 <br>
 It was the same point France was making last night insisting the UK could not have voting rights on legislation in relation to food and drink.</p><p><strong>During his meeting with businesses in Brussels, PM Burnham said his EU deal would add up to 0.5% to the UK’s GDP.</strong></p><p><em>“We’re pretty much there, and it’s a really good deal.”</em></p><p><em>“Treasury analysis out today is saying that now it’s clear up to 0.5% on GDP as a result of the deal. The single biggest growth intervention in this Parliament.”</em></p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/20/uk-eu-european-union-brexit-deal-andy-burnham-latest-news-updates">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>Activists in more than 20 countries demonstrate over cost of living, learning conditions and rising military spending</p><p>Students and young workers have taken to the streets in more than 20 European countries in coordinated protests over the surging cost of living and housing, deteriorating learning conditions and rising military spending.</p><p>Activists from more than 50 groups in countries including Belgium, France, Germany, Greece, Italy, Portugal, Spain and the UK held rallies on Friday, lighting flares, burning cardboard models of tanks and waving placards, many reading “fight for our future”.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/20/young-people-europe-coordinated-protests-cost-of-living">Continue reading...</a></description>

French presidential frontrunner Marine Le Pen on Tuesday denounced an attempt to "derail" her Élysée Palace run after a media report accused the head of her far-right National Rally (RN) party, Jordan Bardella, of making ant-Semitic comments in 2013. Le Pen said Bardella, who is tipped to be prime minister if she wins the presidency, had her "total confidence".
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0a9f2142-bc02-11f1-802a-177f79e345bf/w:1024/p:16x9/191c2d6c2fa59b9137ed69f72204c81d237ccfd9.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0a9f2142-bc02-11f1-802a-177f79e345bf/w:1024/p:16x9/191c2d6c2fa59b9137ed69f72204c81d237ccfd9.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">0b97a704-bc02-11f1-8bbb-ad34ceb9e2f1</guid><pubDate>Tue, 29 Sep 2026 12:33:58 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0a9f2142-bc02-11f1-802a-177f79e345bf/w:1024/p:16x9/191c2d6c2fa59b9137ed69f72204c81d237ccfd9.jpg">© Anne-Christine Poujoulat, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>France puts out massive fire that torched 42,000 hectares and smouldered for 69 days</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/france/20260928-france-puts-out-massive-fire-that-torched-42-000-hectares-and-smouldered-for-69-days</link><description>
France's largest wildfire since 1949 has been declared extinguished more than two months after it broke out in southwestern Gironde, forcing the evacuation of around 224,000 people and covering the city of Bordeaux with a thick plume of smoke. The blaze was put under control on August 1, but continued to smoulder underground for weeks.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0e7d8b7c-bb5e-11f1-99d0-11fa9f8a3b4f/w:1024/p:16x9/b0f91c8b5c330512b36891557fe227255f531c13.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0e7d8b7c-bb5e-11f1-99d0-11fa9f8a3b4f/w:1024/p:16x9/b0f91c8b5c330512b36891557fe227255f531c13.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">0f68114c-bb5e-11f1-a5f5-19c8c18b5c0d</guid><pubDate>Mon, 28 Sep 2026 17:00:08 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0e7d8b7c-bb5e-11f1-99d0-11fa9f8a3b4f/w:1024/p:16x9/b0f91c8b5c330512b36891557fe227255f531c13.jpg">© Julien De Rosa, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Far-right politician Éric Zemmour joins 2027 French presidential race</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/france/20260918-far-right-politician-%C3%A9ric-zemmour-joins-2027-french-presidential-race</link><description>
French far-right politician Éric Zemmour said on Friday that he would run in next year's presidential election, joining far-right candidate Marine Le Pen, who was runner-up to President Emmanuel Macron in the last two elections. Zemmour is campaigning on a crackdown on immigration, including a plan to expel unemployed foreigners even if they are legal residents. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/23bd41de-b33a-11f1-afa9-2538446acac2/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26008389563206.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/23bd41de-b33a-11f1-afa9-2538446acac2/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26008389563206.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">2e6bcd08-b33a-11f1-b960-e76b244d1c83</guid><pubDate>Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:06:31 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/23bd41de-b33a-11f1-afa9-2538446acac2/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26008389563206.jpg">© Emma Da Silva, AP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>French PM vows to cut public spending by €54 billion to reduce deficit</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/france/20260918-french-pm-vows-to-cut-public-spending-by-%E2%82%AC54-billion-to-reduce-deficit</link><description>
Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu said on Thursday that France will cut public spending by €54 billion next year to reduce the country's deficit. The announcement comes seven months ahead of the country's presidential election, and the government is wary of a new wave of demonstrations with a jump in global oil prices sparking concerns over the rising cost of living. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1b1526be-b330-11f1-abde-1d1125ed9143/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26142371784910.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1b1526be-b330-11f1-abde-1d1125ed9143/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26142371784910.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">61b975d6-b32e-11f1-ab9e-b5bbc83805db</guid><pubDate>Fri, 18 Sep 2026 07:23:41 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1b1526be-b330-11f1-abde-1d1125ed9143/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26142371784910.jpg">© Ludovic Marin, AFP via AP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item></channel></rss>

      <title>Anthropic shares slide as AI sell-off hits global markets - as it happened</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/business/live/2026/nov/20/asia-stocks-worst-anthropic-ipo-ai-stock-market-latest-updates-news</link>
      <description><p>Rolling coverage of the latest economic and financial news</p><p>California has served an investigative subpoena on <strong>Nvidia</strong> after a scandal that <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/12/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns">prompted the departure</a> of co-founder and longtime chief executive <strong>Jensen</strong> <strong>Huang</strong>.</p><p><strong>Rob</strong> <strong>Bonta</strong>, the US state’s attorney general, issued the subpoena as part of an investigation into whether exports of the California-based company’s advanced semiconductor chips ended up in China, contravening US restrictions.</p><p>The conduct of <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/nvidia">Nvidia</a> and its former chief executive raises bright red flags, including about the ways in which the company may have misled investors.</p><p>Nvidia is in a messy, transnational situation but the underlying principle of our corporate securities law is clear: Companies cannot mislead their investors.”</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/business/live/2026/nov/20/asia-stocks-worst-anthropic-ipo-ai-stock-market-latest-updates-news">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Anthropic closes first day of public trading at $1.3tn valuation after largest-ever IPO</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/19/anthropic-public-trading-ipo</link>
      <description><p>AI startup and Claude chatbot maker became one of the world’s most valuable publicly traded businesses with final share price of $97</p><ul><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/20/anthropic-ipo-historic-stock-market-debut-key-takeaways-what-next-for-ai">Anthropic’s historic stock market debut: key takeaways, and what comes next for the AI industry</a> </p></li></ul><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/anthropic">Anthropic</a> closed its first day of trading on the US stock market about 17% higher than its initial public offering price. At the close of market on Thursday, Anthropic shares were trading at just over $97 with a nearly $1.3tn total market capitalization, $1.75tn fully diluted.</p><p>While the final share value was higher than the IPO price of $83, it marked a dip from an early high of $111.50. The firm’s shares initially soared 34% when trading got under way on its US market debut on Thursday, valuing the company at more than $2tn. Nonetheless, Anthropic’s ranked among the biggest stock market flotations in history. The <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/artificialintelligenceai">artificial intelligence</a> startup, founded in 2021, became one of the most valuable publicly traded businesses in the world.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/19/anthropic-public-trading-ipo">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Labor leaders call on governments to stop awarding Amazon public contracts</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2026/nov/19/labor-unions-amazon-contracts-open-letter</link>
      <description><p>Union leaders from 19 countries urge reassessment of ties to Amazon, citing company’s poor record on worker rights</p><p>More than 30 labor union leaders from 19 countries are calling on governments to review their public contracts with Amazon and Amazon Web Services, citing the company’s poor record on worker rights and collective bargaining, in an<a href="https://uniglobalunion.org/wp-content/uploads/Amazon-procurement-letter-embargoed-until-nov-19.pdf"> open letter</a> published on Thursday.</p><p>“Amazon’s consistent record of disrespect for workers’ fundamental rights should disqualify it from being awarded public contracts – its behaviour is fundamentally inconsistent with the shared democratic values of our countries,” the union leaders wrote.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2026/nov/19/labor-unions-amazon-contracts-open-letter">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>Company issues first earnings report after ouster of CEO over allegations of affair with suspected Chinese spy</p><p>Nvidia “does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO”, the chairman of the company’s board said Tuesday.       <link>https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/17/deutsche-bank-dimissed-warnings-risky-clients-reports-claim</link>
      <description><p>International investigation using trove of leaked internal data allegedly shows German bank overlooked compliance concerns to safeguard profits</p><p>Deutsche Bank reportedly dismissed warnings about its dealings with risky clients, including high-profile Russian oligarchs, to protect profits, the findings of an investigation into a trove of leaked bank documents indicate.</p><p>A leak of 15m internal files is reported to show that the troubled German bank repeatedly ignored concerns by its compliance officers about its risk-taking, despite having already <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/business/2019/apr/17/deutsche-bank-faces-action-over-20bn-russian-money-laundering-scheme">been caught being used to launder billions of dollars</a> for Russian criminals, spies and oligarchs between 2010 and 2015.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/17/deutsche-bank-dimissed-warnings-risky-clients-reports-claim">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/16/megaspeed-company-breaks-slience-nvidia-jensen-huang-alice-huang</link>
      <description><p>Company insists Alice Huang, who is accused of being a Chinese spy, left business in late 2025</p><ul><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/16/elon-musk-tech-execs-open-letter-jensen-huang-return-nvidia-ceo">Elon Musk joins 165,000 others calling for Nvidia to bring back Jensen Huang</a></p></li><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/business/live/2026/nov/16/ai-sell-off-resumes-jensen-huang-discusses-comeback-nvidia-ceo-dollar-stock-markets-latest-news-updates">Business live – latest updates</a></p></li></ul><p>Megaspeed International, the company linked to the downfall of the Nvidia chief, <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/jensen-huang">Jensen Huang</a>, says it is a “legitimate and lawful business” and has announced that its director, who allegedly had an affair with Jensen Huang, left the business in late 2025.</p><p>The Singapore-based cloud computing company on the weekend said it was “aware of recent media reports containing assertions about our business, supply chain and global operations that are not supported by verifiable evidence”.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/16/megaspeed-company-breaks-slience-nvidia-jensen-huang-alice-huang">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>A layoff and a leap of faith convinced Katie Teixeira she had what it takes to run her own business</p><p>In 2010, Katie Teixeira adopted a kitten found all alone in an abandoned house. The latest information, news and events in France, Europe and around the world.</description><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/</link><lastBuildDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:45:27 GMT</lastBuildDate><atom:link href="https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/rss" rel="self" type="application/rss+xml"/><item><category>France</category><title>Depardieu and Houellebecq accused of gang rape on French film set</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261120-depardieu-and-houellebecq-accused-of-gang-rape-on-french-film-set</link><description>
Paris prosecutors have opened an investigation after an actress filed a complaint alleging that she was raped by a group including actor Gérard Depardieu and high-profile French author Michel Houellebecq on the set of the film Thalasso in 2018. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/5f6cabe8-e1a7-11f1-8f6a-3f371022a770/w:1024/p:16x9/gerry.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/5f6cabe8-e1a7-11f1-8f6a-3f371022a770/w:1024/p:16x9/gerry.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">ec3acb0c-e4dd-11f1-9619-3935a39ed096</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:24:55 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/5f6cabe8-e1a7-11f1-8f6a-3f371022a770/w:1024/p:16x9/gerry.jpg">REUTERS - Gonzalo Fuentes</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>France probes suspected leaks from interior ministry to far-right National Rally</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261120-france-probes-suspected-leaks-from-interior-ministry-to-far-right-national-rally</link><description>
France has opened a probe into suspicions that a senior official at the interior ministry leaked secret information to the far-right National Rally (RN) party, which is itself facing a number of investigations, prosecutors have said.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/0777260e-e45c-11f1-a6ff-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/000-9QL2XA.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/0777260e-e45c-11f1-a6ff-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/000-9QL2XA.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">5be0a25a-e4b2-11f1-be46-714476ef8919</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:55:01 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/0777260e-e45c-11f1-a6ff-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/000-9QL2XA.jpg">© Pascal Guyot / AFP</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>French union leader warns strikes will continue without higher wages</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261120-french-union-leader-warns-strikes-will-continue-without-higher-wages-cgt-sophie-binet-interview</link><description>
French trade unions have promised to call more strikes and demonstrations, arguing that a government proposal to increase the minimum wage fails to address the social crisis that has spurred protests across the country. Sophie Binet, head of the CGT union, says even after six weeks of action, workers and students are more determined than ever to keep up the fight.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/60fce194-d932-11f1-aa3d-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-05T160039Z-986160219-RC2PHOAZFNU3-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/60fce194-d932-11f1-aa3d-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-05T160039Z-986160219-RC2PHOAZFNU3-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">37c8b342-e40f-11f1-a821-bd0c1d2fd9c6</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 06:07:21 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/60fce194-d932-11f1-aa3d-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-05T160039Z-986160219-RC2PHOAZFNU3-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg">© REUTERS - Sarah Meyssonnier </source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>Spotlight on France</category><title>Podcast: Living on the breadline, France's 35-hour week and a divisive tax</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/podcasts/spotlight-on-france/20261119-podcast-living-on-minimum-wage-smic-35-hour-working-week-france-second-biggest-tax-csg</link><description>
The French government's decision to raise the minimum wage has failed to satisfy protesters struggling to make ends meet amid the cost-of-living crisis. Also, did the introduction of the 35-hour working week actually help reduce unemployment? The evidence is mixed. And a look at the history of France's second-largest tax, the CSG, and why it's dividing politicians. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/8a275ba4-e41c-11f1-8716-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/episode-spotlight-on-france-episode-153-light-blue.png"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/8a275ba4-e41c-11f1-8716-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/episode-spotlight-on-france-episode-153-light-blue.png" type="image/png" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">da07160a-e41c-11f1-9424-dd481487d627</guid><pubDate>Thu, 19 Nov 2026 16:19:04 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Sarah Elzas</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>France raises bird flu alert to highest level as infections spread across Europe</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261119-france-raises-bird-flu-alert-to-highest-level-as-infections-spread-across-europe</link><description>
France is raising its avian flu alert to the highest level from Friday, bringing new restrictions on poultry movements as authorities seek to contain the spread of the virus. The decision comes amid a rise in infections among wild birds across Europe, particularly along migration routes crossing France.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/42222ee2-1fab-11eb-b845-005056bf87d6/w:1024/p:16x9/6850244_699464634-000-ft7gh.png"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/42222ee2-1fab-11eb-b845-005056bf87d6/w:1024/p:16x9/6850244_699464634-000-ft7gh.png" type="image/png" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">eff2afda-e3f7-11f1-a0c0-bdb47d3d53b3</guid><pubDate>Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:12:37 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/42222ee2-1fab-11eb-b845-005056bf87d6/w:1024/p:16x9/6850244_699464634-000-ft7gh.png">© GAIZKA IROZ / AFP</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>France rejects 'absurd' Russian claims of direct involvement in Ukraine war</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261118-france-rejects-absurd-russian-claims-of-direct-involvement-in-ukraine-war</link><description>
The French government on Tuesday dismissed Russian accusations that France is directly involved in the war in Ukraine, following an RFI investigation which revealed a small number of French soldiers have been carrying out training and equipment maintenance missions on Ukrainian territory.

      <title>Premier League: 10 things to look out for this weekend</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/20/premier-league-10-things-to-look-out-for-this-weekend</link>
      <description><p>Bruno Guimarães to feel the heat on Tyneside, Alex Scott’s return further cheers Cherries and Manchester City face favourite whipping boys</p><p>After three Premier League defeats on the spin, Manchester City need something or someone to come along and put some pep in their step, and Fulham look like just the thing – after all, in the past 15 years these teams have played 20 times in all competitions, and City have won precisely 20 of those games. Their current run of 17 successive league wins against Fulham is the longest run of victories by one club against a single opponent in English top-flight history. It is a reflection of the changing realities of English football, and the gulf that has opened between the teams that dominate it and those who seek to challenge them, that of the top 10 such runs all but one occurred in whole or in part after 2010 and six of them have been achieved by Sheikh Mansour’s Manchester City, with Chelsea responsible for another two, Manchester United one, and Portsmouth’s postwar, 13-game supremacy over Everton – a wild ride that included two 5-0s, a 5-1, a 6-3 and a 7-0 – the anomaly. <strong>Simon Burnton</strong></p><p><em>Manchester City v Fulham, Saturday 12.30pm (all times GMT)</em></p><p><em>Aston Villa v Sunderland, Saturday 3pm</em></p><p><em>Bournemouth v Nottingham Forest, Saturday 3pm</em></p><p><em>Chelsea v Leeds</em><em>, Saturday 3pm</em></p><p><em>Coventry v Crystal Palace, Saturday 3pm</em></p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/20/premier-league-10-things-to-look-out-for-this-weekend">Continue reading...</a></description>
      <category domain="https://www.theguardian.com/football/football">Football</category>
      <category domain="https://www.theguardian.com/sport/sport">Sport</category>
      <category domain="https://www.theguardian.com/football/premierleague">Premier League</category>
      <category domain="https://www.theguardian.com/football/manchestercity">Manchester City</category>
      <category domain="https://www.theguardian.com/football/fulham">Fulham</category>
      <category domain="https://www.theguardian.com/football/aston-villa">Aston Villa</category>

      <title>What history tells us about the Premier League table after 10 games of a season</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/20/premier-league-table-history-after-10-games-season</link>
      <description><p>Past years suggest it is tough to make big positional gains after slow start but that someone now safe will be relegated</p><p>The Premier League is about to enter the most intense phase of its season. After 10 rounds of fixtures across the past three months there are 10 in the next seven weeks. Yet if you hibernated for winter, most clubs would be in roughly the same position no matter when in spring you emerged.</p><p>Across the past decade, Premier League teams’ positions changed by an average of 2.6 places between matchweeks 10 and 38. Only 5.5 clubs per season moved by more than three places over the final 28 games, with almost half of the teams (89 out of 200) shifting by a single spot at most. Every club other than Arsenal will be looking to improve their position but they need not trouble themselves too much. History shows they will probably finish 2026-27 close to their current standing.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/20/premier-league-table-history-after-10-games-season">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Danny Kelly loved football and never forgot the absurdity of earning a living talking about it | Max Rushden</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/19/danny-kelly-death-football-radio</link>
      <description><p>The journalist and broadcaster who died last week aged 69 knew the enduring power of radio, even as the landscape changed so quickly</p><p>It’s injury time at the Emirates on 29 October 2008, Arsenal are 4-3 up against Tottenham. Tom Huddlestone cushions a ball to Luka Modric, whose strike takes a deflection. It loops over Manuel Almunia and off a post into the path of Aaron Lennon, <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2008/oct/30/premierleague-arsenal">who prods it home</a> and starts skipping towards the Spurs supporters before diving on to the ground and being enveloped by Modric, Benoît Assou-Ekotto, Darren Bent and a couple of pitch-invading fans. Pandemonium, for once, seems the apt way to describe it.</p><p>But the real entertainment is happening in a radio studio at 18 Hatfields, London SE1; the old home of TalkSport. As the goal goes in, a guttural voice makes an indecipherable but very loud noise. It’s hard to transcribe – perhaps “ERRRRRAAAARRRGGHH”, or maybe “OOEEERRAAGGH”. It’s just a noise, but it’s unmistakably Danny Kelly. He regains the power of speech and follows it up with: “Gooooaaaal … Goalll Stan, Goalll at the Emirates.” Reporter Ian Abrahams and Stan Collymore join the excitement, before Danny comes back: “I LOVE FOOTBALL, STAN, I LOVE IT.” It is <a href="https://www.facebook.com/THFCOnThisDay/videos/i-love-football-stan-i-love-itrest-in-peace-danny-kelly-/3113435382350217/">such a brilliant piece of radio</a>. From one of the absolute greats.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/19/danny-kelly-death-football-radio">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Gonzalo García: ‘I love Craven Cottage – the fans can reach out and touch you’</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/19/gonzalo-garcia-fulham-spain-premier-leaue-interview</link>
      <description><p>Spain Under-21 striker admits the pace of the Premier League has surprised him but says he must stay calm over goal drought at Fulham</p><p>The first thing Rita Hayworth’s great nephew says when he walks in is: “Sorry I’m late.” Gonzalo García is not late, but it’s very like him: he is impeccably polite, accommodating, and there’s an almost gentle quality to him, a calm that’s not common but can help, especially in moments when the pressure builds. There’s a reason one of the coaches standing in the rain by the pitch where Spain’s under‑21s have just finished training says everyone here loves García. The Fulham striker shakes hands, introduces himself and ducks into the dressing room to change; then a few minutes later he’s back, apologising for a wait that wasn’t one.</p><p>Time to talk, so let’s start with Tinseltown, the family tale. García laughs. His great-aunt, born Margarita Carmen Cansino, was among the biggest stars in Hollywood, although he’s not sure he’s seen any of her films. His grandfather was a surgeon and others in the family followed. His uncles played rugby for Spain, but that wasn’t his thing. As for him, he enrolled in a degree in business management and analytics, and reckons he might have liked law, yet even that wasn’t his chosen field.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/19/gonzalo-garcia-fulham-spain-premier-leaue-interview">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/19/thomas-frank-crystal-palace-premier-league</link>
      <description><ul><li><p>Dane was sacked by Tottenham in February</p></li><li><p>‘I know what I want and the direction we should go in’</p></li></ul><p>Thomas Frank has admitted he has a point to prove on his return to management as he aims to steer Crystal Palace away from relegation trouble after taking over from Pierre Sage.</p><p>The Dane was <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/16/thomas-frank-confirmed-crystal-palace-manager-pierre-sage">confirmed as manager on Monday</a> with Palace at the bottom of the table after 10 matches having conceded 24 goals – the most in the Premier League.       <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/19/mls-salary-release-lionel-messi-spent-per-point</link>
      <description><p>How much in player salaries did it take to earn a point in the 2026 MLS regular season? The latest batch of salaries lends some insight</p><p>Lionel Messi has closer company at the top of MLS’s list of highest-paid players, thanks to another pair of former Barcelona attackers. The Inter Miami captain is still comfortably the league’s top earner, on a guaranteed compensation of $28.3m. Robert Lewandowski (Chicago Fire) and Antoine Griezmann (Orlando City) have entered the list with the second and third highest wages, while Atlanta United’s Breel Embolo, another summer signing, ranks fifth on a guaranteed compensation of $10.8m. Second-year LAFC forward Son Heung-min sits fourth on $11.2m.</p><p>Casimiro, who joined Messi in Miami at the end of his contract with Manchester United, is his team’s fourth top-earner with a guaranteed compensation of $3.54m. This comes after Miami announced his signing as a non-designated player to the surprise of some as the Brazilian arrived on a Bosman transfer rather than a loan-with-purchase, as Rodrigo De Paul had last summer, to keep Miami rules compliant. The MLS Players’ Association lists Casimiro on a base salary of $896,004.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/19/mls-salary-release-lionel-messi-spent-per-point">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Inside women’s football’s difficult rise in Syria: ‘A joy that everyone in the country needed’</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/19/syria-womens-football</link>
      <description><p>A 14-year civil war ravaged the country and ground women’s football to a halt. Today, the first glimmers of hope are beginning to emerge amid difficulty</p><p>In December 2024, Syria’s under-18 women’s football team boarded a last-minute bus at midnight from Aqaba, bound for Damascus. The players had been in Jordan preparing for their final match of the WAFF women’s championship, where a win against Saudi Arabia would have kept their hopes of winning the title alive. Syria pulled out amid fears that the border would close.</p><p>Back home, a war that had been largely frozen for four years was suddenly moving at pace. Rebel forces had swept out of the northwest, taking Aleppo and were pushing south towards the capital, 350km away, threatening to topple the now-former president, Bashar al-Assad. Players from the provinces around Damascus made their way home. But those from Hasakah, in the country’s far north-east, spent the next three days stranded at Damascus airport, as airline staff fled and planes sat idle on the tarmac, until a bus was finally able to take them home.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/19/syria-womens-football">Continue reading...</a></description>

La sécheresse s'installe durablement en Outre-mer. Le manque d'eau fragilise les cultures et menace les récoltes aux Antilles et à La Réunion. La situation est également très préoccupante en Guyane, où le niveau du fleuve continue de baisser.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/d5ba9aa2-e4f5-11f1-a177-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/capture-e00d5d0f.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/d5ba9aa2-e4f5-11f1-a177-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/capture-e00d5d0f.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">668bbe98-e4ca-11f1-b006-117a06c45e07</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:36:16 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator></dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>REPLAY - Costa, Von der Leyen et Burnham réunis au sommet UE-Royaume-Uni</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261120-replay-costa-von-der-leyen-et-burnham-r%C3%A9unis-au-sommet-ue-royaume-uni</link><description>
 Le Premier ministre britannique Andy Burnham et les dirigeants de l'Union européenne ouvrent vendredi, lors d'un sommet à Bruxelles, le premier chapitre d'une nouvelle entente post-Brexit, en s'appuyant sur plusieurs accords concrets.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/8210dede-e4f0-11f1-b65f-ebb478925cf0/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261120-140818-143909-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/8210dede-e4f0-11f1-b65f-ebb478925cf0/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261120-140818-143909-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">86bb5cde-e4f0-11f1-b940-650f895e6464</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:30:45 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category>À l'Affiche !</category><title>"Blade Runner 2099", "Black Doves", "Alice"... le meilleur des séries du mois de novembre</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/%C3%A0-l-affiche/20261120-blade-runner-2099-black-doves-alice-le-meilleur-des-s%C3%A9ries-du-mois-de-novembre</link><description>
Pour "À l'Affiche", Nina Masson et Sonia Patricelli décryptent les meilleures sorties du mois. "Blade Runner 2099" frappe fort pour cette série nouvelle génération sur Prime Video. </description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/2680dcea-e4e6-11f1-8ca4-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/DLS-AFF-BLADE-RUNNER-2099-frame-658.jpeg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/2680dcea-e4e6-11f1-8ca4-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/DLS-AFF-BLADE-RUNNER-2099-frame-658.jpeg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">e76b9bf8-e4e5-11f1-ae24-a91a5eeb246b</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:51:43 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Nina MASSON</dc:creator></item><item><category>Tech 24</category><title>Intelligence artificielle : les secrets de l'entrée en bourse record d'Anthropic</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/tech-24/20261120-intelligence-artificielle-les-secrets-de-l-entr%C3%A9e-en-bourse-record-d-anthropic</link><description>
Une intelligence artificielle qui tente de faire chanter un dirigeant, des stars d'Hollywood qui décrochent le jackpot, un laboratoire secret qui explore les mystères de l'ADN, des philosophes chargés d'enseigner la morale aux machines… l'introduction en bourse record d'Anthropic – la maison mère de Claude –, est aussi celle de la démesure. La première journée, l'entreprise californienne a levé 81 milliards de dollars, soit davantage que l'ancien record établi par SpaceX. Un château de cartes ?
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0f6019ba-e444-11f1-84a0-ebb478925cf0/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-19T164121Z-1052802186-RC22ROAU8AOI-RTRMADP-3-USA-IPO-ANTHROPIC.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0f6019ba-e444-11f1-84a0-ebb478925cf0/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-19T164121Z-1052802186-RC22ROAU8AOI-RTRMADP-3-USA-IPO-ANTHROPIC.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">433e6f12-e4ca-11f1-9b95-73677292cd28</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:49:12 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Guillaume GRALLET</dc:creator></item><item><category>Éco/Tech</category><title>Après une introduction en Bourse record, l'action d'Anthropic chute de 9 %</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9co-tech/20261120-apr%C3%A8s-une-introduction-en-bourse-record-l-action-d-anthropic-chute-de-9</link><description>
La start-up américaine d'intelligence artificielle Anthropic chute vendredi 20 novembre à Wall Street malgré une entrée en Bourse historique, soit une baisse de 9 % pour sa deuxième journée.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/2d76f880-e4f1-11f1-b071-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/169af1cdfd2e904760ba3ff4561a4c65ef1cc80e.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/2d76f880-e4f1-11f1-b071-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/169af1cdfd2e904760ba3ff4561a4c65ef1cc80e.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">2f0deda2-e4f1-11f1-b4b4-3d5c680d49ca</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:46:33 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/2d76f880-e4f1-11f1-b071-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/169af1cdfd2e904760ba3ff4561a4c65ef1cc80e.jpg">© Leonardo Munoz, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>ActuElles</category><title>Les féminicides, la partie émergée du contrôle coercitif</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/actuelles/20261120-les-f%C3%A9minicides-la-partie-%C3%A9merg%C3%A9e-du-contr%C3%B4le-coercitif</link><description>
Les féminicides font aussi des victimes invisibles : les proches des femmes assassinées, confrontées à un deuil impossible et à des embûches judiciaires. Dans 75 % des cas, le féminicide survient sans violences physiques préalables, mais au terme d'une période de contrôle coercitif :  une prison invisible faite d'emprise et de violences psychologiques, explique l'historienne Christelle Taraud, qui décrit des victimes "zombifiées" par leur tortionnaire.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/804fd37e-e4e7-11f1-94db-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/actuelles-4.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/804fd37e-e4e7-11f1-94db-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/actuelles-4.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">012b0ea0-e4e8-11f1-954f-b12e286687bf</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:46:33 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Laure MANENT</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Gérard Depardieu et Michel Houellebecq accusés de viol en réunion et d'agressions sexuelles</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261120-g%C3%A9rard-depardieu-et-michel-houellebecq-accus%C3%A9s-de-viol-en-r%C3%A9union-et-d-agressions-sexuelles</link><description>
Gérard Depardieu est de nouveau accusé de viol – en réunion cette fois, avec la complicité supposée de l'écrivain Michel Houellebecq, selon des sources proches du dossier, confirmant vendredi des révélations de Mediapart. Les faits, dénoncés par une comédienne, remonteraient au tournage du film "Thalasso" en 2018.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/112bfeb0-e4f0-11f1-97c4-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/5b316d0d8e9e019339c005a7e2173a2aacfd39e4.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/112bfeb0-e4f0-11f1-97c4-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/5b316d0d8e9e019339c005a7e2173a2aacfd39e4.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">11ebaaf8-e4f0-11f1-af7a-57d065e8beab</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:38:36 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/112bfeb0-e4f0-11f1-97c4-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/5b316d0d8e9e019339c005a7e2173a2aacfd39e4.jpg">© Dimitar Dilkoff, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>France-Tchad : vers un retour de la coopération militaire ?</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261120-france-tchad-vers-un-retour-de-la-coop%C3%A9ration-militaire</link><description>
Sommes-nous en train d’assister à une reprise de la coopération militaire entre le Tchad et la France ? Deux ans après la rupture des accords de défense, l’armée française est de nouveau présente sur le sol tchadien. N’Djamena évoque un exercice conjoint, après l’atterrissage de deux Mirage 2000 et d’un avion de transport militaire. "Une escale technique de courte durée", affirme le porte-parole des armées françaises.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/36ea475e-e4e8-11f1-89c4-ebb478925cf0/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261119-214403-214535-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/36ea475e-e4e8-11f1-89c4-ebb478925cf0/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261119-214403-214535-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">3be3788e-e4e8-11f1-8122-5fce42be976a</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:32:51 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>La Tunisie se prépare à éviter les coupures d'électricité pendant l'été 2027</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261120-la-tunisie-se-pr%C3%A9pare-%C3%A0-%C3%A9viter-les-coupures-d-%C3%A9lectricit%C3%A9-pendant-l-%C3%A9t%C3%A9-2027</link><description>
🇹🇳 La Tunisie anticipe déjà l’été 2027 après une saison 2026 marquée par de fortes coupures d’eau et d’électricité. La Chambre de commerce mixte a organisé une réunion pour réfléchir à comment éviter une nouvelle crise l'année prochaine.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/77f2dd3a-e4eb-11f1-8d80-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/Couv-TUNISIE-R%C3%A9union-coupure-%C3%A9lectricit%C3%A9.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/77f2dd3a-e4eb-11f1-8d80-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/Couv-TUNISIE-R%C3%A9union-coupure-%C3%A9lectricit%C3%A9.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">7cd7f10a-e4eb-11f1-a97a-a9bcef4fc310</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:13:02 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Tchad : vers une reprise de la coopération militaire avec la France ?</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261120-tchad-vers-une-reprise-de-la-coop%C3%A9ration-militaire-avec-la-france</link><description>
Deux ans après la rupture des accords de défense, la présence de deux Mirage 2000 et d’un avion de transport militaire français à N’Djamena relance les interrogations sur une éventuelle reprise de la coopération militaire entre les deux pays. Si les autorités tchadiennes évoquent un exercice conjoint, l’armée française parle d’une simple escale technique de courte durée.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1f23975a-e4df-11f1-b5d8-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/TCHAD-FRANCE.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1f23975a-e4df-11f1-b5d8-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/TCHAD-FRANCE.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">3a274cc2-e4df-11f1-b301-b1154e870037</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 13:39:05 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Journée mondiale de l’enfance : l’Unesco alerte sur les besoins de financement</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261120-journ%C3%A9e-mondiale-de-l-enfance-l-unesco-alerte-sur-les-besoins-de-financement</link><description>
À l’occasion de la Journée mondiale de l’enfance, l’Unesco présente un rapport consacré au financement de l’éducation et de la protection de la petite enfance. Ce document, coproduit avec l’Unicef et l’OCDE, dresse un état des lieux des investissements dans ce secteur essentiel. Borhene Chakroun, directeur de l’apprentissage tout au long de la vie à l’Unesco est notre invité.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/d75be13a-e4d3-11f1-860d-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261120-081641-082644-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/d75be13a-e4d3-11f1-860d-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261120-081641-082644-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">dcb4c43a-e4d3-11f1-9883-0bc84aa6ff32</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 13:35:40 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Europe</category><title>Deux missiles russes chutent en Pologne, le Premier ministre Tusk dénonce "une provocation"</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/europe/20261120-deux-missiles-chutent-pologne-premier-ministre-donald-tusk-d%C3%A9nonce-provocation-russie</link><description>
Le ministre polonais de la Défense a indiqué que deux missiles russes et vraisemblablement un drone à réaction sont tombés dans le sud-est de la Pologne, frontalier de l'Ukraine, sans faire de blessés. Le Premier ministre polonais Donald Tusk a dénoncé "une provocation" de Moscou.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/de0c6a98-c58b-11f1-b1f4-e362370cce2e/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D2WA8KF.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/de0c6a98-c58b-11f1-b1f4-e362370cce2e/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D2WA8KF.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">160a28f8-e4e1-11f1-866c-130278cdd5a3</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 13:03:50 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/de0c6a98-c58b-11f1-b1f4-e362370cce2e/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D2WA8KF.jpg">© Ludovic Marin, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Madagascar : le procès de l'empoisonnement présumé de 31 personnes s'est ouvert</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261120-madagascar-le-proc%C3%A8s-de-l-empoisonnement-pr%C3%A9sum%C3%A9-de-31-personnes-s-est-ouvert</link><description>
🇲🇬 À Madagascar, le procès sur la mort d’une trentaine de personnes après un anniversaire en juin 2025 s’est ouvert mardi. Un an et demi après les faits, les causes du drame restent inconnues. Le témoignage d’un médecin évoque désormais la présence de GHB et de méthanol dans les analyses. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/e3e86e5e-e4de-11f1-9390-ebb478925cf0/w:1024/p:16x9/Couv-MADAGASCAR-Proc%C3%A8s-intoxication.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/e3e86e5e-e4de-11f1-9390-ebb478925cf0/w:1024/p:16x9/Couv-MADAGASCAR-Proc%C3%A8s-intoxication.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">33a74c80-e4df-11f1-8410-371e30f35703</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:54:30 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Sports</category><title>Une revanche à prendre : la France affrontera l'Espagne en quarts de finale de la Ligue des nations</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/sports/20261120-revanche-%C3%A0-prendre-france-affrontera-espagne-quarts-de-finale-ligue-des-nations</link><description>
L'équipe de France retrouvera les champions du monde en titre en quarts de finale de Ligue des nations. Le tirage au sort effectué vendredi à Nyon, en Suisse, a placé l'Espagne sur le chemin des Bleus de Zidane.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/db96a0ae-e4d9-11f1-b56d-ebb478925cf0/w:1024/p:16x9/000-C27T4RN.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/db96a0ae-e4d9-11f1-b56d-ebb478925cf0/w:1024/p:16x9/000-C27T4RN.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">3d061022-e4da-11f1-9892-fd4118598c59</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:12:29 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/db96a0ae-e4d9-11f1-b56d-ebb478925cf0/w:1024/p:16x9/000-C27T4RN.jpg">© Franck Fife, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Amazonie : une partie du peuple Awa sort de l’isolement et cela inquiète les associations</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261120-amazonie-une-partie-du-peuple-awa-sort-de-l-isolement-et-cela-inqui%C3%A8te-les-associations</link><description>
Membres du peuple Awa, ces autochtones volontairement coupés du monde ont atteint, lundi 16 novembre, un village et un poste du gouvernement dans la réserve autochtone Arariboia, au Brésil. Le groupe a fait une courte apparition avant de regagner la forêt, emportant avec lui des ignames, des tubercules locaux, a précisé l'association Survival International.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/f9e81660-e4d8-11f1-89ac-ebb478925cf0/w:1024/p:16x9/miniapeupleawa.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/f9e81660-e4d8-11f1-89ac-ebb478925cf0/w:1024/p:16x9/miniapeupleawa.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">037dd4e4-e4d9-11f1-9dc0-77dced1358b9</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:04:59 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><title>🔴 En direct : Paris demande une réunion du Conseil de sécurité après les frappes russes ayant touché des ambassades européennes à Kiev</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/europe/20261120-en-direct-trois-morts-et-deux-ponts-endommag%C3%A9s-%C3%A0-kiev-suite-%C3%A0-des-frappes-russes</link><description></description><guid isPermaLink="false">583ec91a-e4da-11f1-b928-790c017cbaa5</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:03:05 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Reporters</category><title>Jamaïque : plages interdites</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/reporters/20261120-jama%C3%AFque-plages-interdites</link><description>
Si on vous parle de la Jamaïque, vous visualisez sans doute une longue plage de sable fin et un air de reggae. Mais cette image paradisiaque se heurte à la réalité. Aujourd'hui, seulement 0,6 % des plus de mille kilomètres de côtes jamaïcaines sont accessibles librement aux habitants de l'île. Le paradoxe est brutal : la Jamaïque vend ses plages au monde entier et les interdit à ses propres citoyens.  
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1952df8c-e41e-11f1-b8ec-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/Reporters-3.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1952df8c-e41e-11f1-b8ec-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/Reporters-3.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">f8ca1640-e41d-11f1-bcc5-6358196f9743</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:46:12 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Laurence CUVILLIER</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Dominique de Villepin annonce sa candidature à l'élection présidentielle de 2027</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261120-pr%C3%A9sidentielle-2027-l-ancien-premier-ministre-dominique-de-villepin-annonce-sa-candidature</link><description>
Dominique de Villepin a officialisé vendredi 20 novembre sa candidature à l'élection présidentielle de 2027. L'ex-Premier ministre se présente comme une alternative au macronisme, à La France insoumise et au Rassemblement national.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/9fb85a8a-e4d6-11f1-8eb3-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/miniadefvillepin.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/9fb85a8a-e4d6-11f1-8eb3-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/miniadefvillepin.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">c6c746ae-e4d6-11f1-8ffb-375f4fe00708</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:42:32 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>COP31 : les énergies fossiles disparaissent du projet de décision finale</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261120-cop31-les-%C3%A9nergies-fossiles-disparaissent-du-projet-de-d%C3%A9cision-finale</link><description>
Les énergies fossiles ont disparu du nouveau projet de décision finale de la COP31 sur le climat publié jeudi à Antalya (Turquie), un recul vivement dénoncé par les ONG à la veille de la fin théorique des négociations.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/d2db63b6-e4d2-11f1-966b-ebb478925cf0/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261120-080149-080348-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/d2db63b6-e4d2-11f1-966b-ebb478925cf0/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261120-080149-080348-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">d863a9c4-e4d2-11f1-9cfc-f74c1ae58bbf</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:15:41 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Anthropic signe une entrée en Bourse historique, malgré les turbulences pour l'IA</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261120-anthropic-signe-une-entr%C3%A9e-en-bourse-historique-malgr%C3%A9-les-turbulences-pour-l-ia</link><description>
La start-up américaine Anthropic a créé l'événement jeudi pour ses débuts à Wall Street, son titre enregistrant une nette progression malgré un contexte de marché peu favorable aux valeurs de l'intelligence artificielle (IA).
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1f7a3724-e4d3-11f1-a2da-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261120-081336-081519-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1f7a3724-e4d3-11f1-a2da-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261120-081336-081519-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">24412b5a-e4d3-11f1-a9ac-61854534eb64</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:14:44 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Sénégal : la loi de finances rectificative passe par décret présidentiel</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261120-s%C3%A9n%C3%A9gal-la-loi-de-finances-rectificative-passe-par-d%C3%A9cret-pr%C3%A9sidentiel</link><description>
🇸🇳 Le président Bassirou Diomaye Faye impose par décret le budget rectificatif 2026, malgré son rejet par la majorité parlementaire. Une décision qui intervient alors que le Sénégal, lourdement endetté, négocie une aide financière avec le FMI. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/302f1e28-e4fa-11f1-ad28-ebb478925cf0/w:1024/p:16x9/Capture-d-e%CC%81cran-2026-11-20-a%CC%80-16-50-27.png"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/302f1e28-e4fa-11f1-ad28-ebb478925cf0/w:1024/p:16x9/Capture-d-e%CC%81cran-2026-11-20-a%CC%80-16-50-27.png" type="image/png" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">64e6172c-e4d0-11f1-9e71-2b7d5c052f36</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:05:35 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Focus</category><title>Génocide des Rohingya : en Malaisie, une communauté de plus en plus rejetée</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/focus/20261120-g%C3%A9nocide-des-rohingya-en-malaisie-une-communaut%C3%A9-de-plus-en-plus-rejet%C3%A9e</link><description>
Le 19 novembre, la Cour internationale de justice a reconnu que la Birmanie avait commis un génocide contre les Rohingya en 2017. Une décision saluée par cette communauté, toujours persécutée dans son pays d'origine. Mais en Malaisie, où elle avait longtemps bénéficié d'un soutien favorable, le climat se dégrade. Des discours de haine et des appels à l'expulsion se multiplient sur les réseaux sociaux. Reportage de Théo Collet, Aruna Popuri, Constantin Simon et Alix Ostian.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/a4133a2c-e441-11f1-beda-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-NW-OOV-ECRAN-FREEZE-MALAYSIA-ROHIGNYA-RACISM-BAIN-Lauren.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/a4133a2c-e441-11f1-beda-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-NW-OOV-ECRAN-FREEZE-MALAYSIA-ROHIGNYA-RACISM-BAIN-Lauren.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">af6d59e0-e444-11f1-939b-41d0c91ce3bc</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:01:27 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Théo COLLET</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Présidentielle 2027 : Dominique de Villepin annonce sa candidature</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261120-pr%C3%A9sidentielle-2027-dominique-de-villepin-annonce-sa-candidature</link><description>
L'ex-Premier ministre Dominique de Villepin a officialisé vendredi sa candidature à l'élection présidentielle de 2027 en se présentant comme une alternative au macronisme, à La France insoumise et au Rassemblement national, qu'il juge responsables d'un "pourrissement" du pays.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1b442fc2-e4d1-11f1-84c1-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261120-113728-114407-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1b442fc2-e4d1-11f1-84c1-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261120-113728-114407-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">20c78444-e4d1-11f1-8273-7fcda4110501</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:00:04 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Sommet des alliés de l'Ukraine : quelles avancées après les discussions ?</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261120-sommet-des-alli%C3%A9s-de-l-ukraine-quelles-avanc%C3%A9es-apr%C3%A8s-les-discussions</link><description>
L'émissaire américain Jared Kushner a déclaré jeudi que les États-Unis seraient disposés à accorder à l'Ukraine une protection de type Otan, si cela était dans leur "intérêt", et souligné que la Russie en avait accepté "le concept".
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/8f3e59b4-e4ce-11f1-bc5a-ebb478925cf0/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261120-110809-110958-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/8f3e59b4-e4ce-11f1-bc5a-ebb478925cf0/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261120-110809-110958-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">9446c39c-e4ce-11f1-a148-ab88217f5919</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:57:33 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item></channel></rss>

<rss version="2.0" xmlns:atom="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom" xmlns:media="http://search.yahoo.com/mrss/" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><channel><language>fr</language><title>France : News et actualité en continu - France 24</title><description>France 24  couvre les évènements en France et en Outre-mer : politique, culture, faits de société, énergie, crise sociale, sport, santé, avec ses reportages, enquêtes, débats et analyses.</description><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/</link><lastBuildDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:36:17 GMT</lastBuildDate><atom:link href="https://www.france24.com/fr/france/rss" rel="self" type="application/rss+xml"/><item><category>Outre-Mer</category><title>De l'océan Indien aux Caraïbes, la sécheresse frappe plusieurs territoires d'Outre-mer</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/outre-mer/20261120-de-l-oc%C3%A9an-indien-aux-cara%C3%AFbes-la-s%C3%A9cheresse-frappe-plusieurs-territoires-d-outre-mer</link><description>
La sécheresse s'installe durablement en Outre-mer. Le manque d'eau fragilise les cultures et menace les récoltes aux Antilles et à La Réunion. La situation est également très préoccupante en Guyane, où le niveau du fleuve continue de baisser.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/d5ba9aa2-e4f5-11f1-a177-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/capture-e00d5d0f.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/d5ba9aa2-e4f5-11f1-a177-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/capture-e00d5d0f.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">668bbe98-e4ca-11f1-b006-117a06c45e07</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:36:16 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator></dc:creator></item><item><category>ActuElles</category><title>Les féminicides, la partie émergée du contrôle coercitif</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/actuelles/20261120-les-f%C3%A9minicides-la-partie-%C3%A9merg%C3%A9e-du-contr%C3%B4le-coercitif</link><description>
Les féminicides font aussi des victimes invisibles : les proches des femmes assassinées, confrontées à un deuil impossible et à des embûches judiciaires. Dans 75 % des cas, le féminicide survient sans violences physiques préalables, mais au terme d'une période de contrôle coercitif :  une prison invisible faite d'emprise et de violences psychologiques, explique l'historienne Christelle Taraud, qui décrit des victimes "zombifiées" par leur tortionnaire.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/804fd37e-e4e7-11f1-94db-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/actuelles-4.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/804fd37e-e4e7-11f1-94db-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/actuelles-4.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">012b0ea0-e4e8-11f1-954f-b12e286687bf</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:46:33 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Laure MANENT</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Gérard Depardieu et Michel Houellebecq accusés de viol en réunion et d'agressions sexuelles</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261120-g%C3%A9rard-depardieu-et-michel-houellebecq-accus%C3%A9s-de-viol-en-r%C3%A9union-et-d-agressions-sexuelles</link><description>
Gérard Depardieu est de nouveau accusé de viol – en réunion cette fois, avec la complicité supposée de l'écrivain Michel Houellebecq, selon des sources proches du dossier, confirmant vendredi des révélations de Mediapart. Les faits, dénoncés par une comédienne, remonteraient au tournage du film "Thalasso" en 2018.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/112bfeb0-e4f0-11f1-97c4-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/5b316d0d8e9e019339c005a7e2173a2aacfd39e4.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/112bfeb0-e4f0-11f1-97c4-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/5b316d0d8e9e019339c005a7e2173a2aacfd39e4.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">11ebaaf8-e4f0-11f1-af7a-57d065e8beab</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:38:36 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/112bfeb0-e4f0-11f1-97c4-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/5b316d0d8e9e019339c005a7e2173a2aacfd39e4.jpg">© Dimitar Dilkoff, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Dominique de Villepin annonce sa candidature à l'élection présidentielle de 2027</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261120-pr%C3%A9sidentielle-2027-l-ancien-premier-ministre-dominique-de-villepin-annonce-sa-candidature</link><description>
Dominique de Villepin a officialisé vendredi 20 novembre sa candidature à l'élection présidentielle de 2027. L'ex-Premier ministre se présente comme une alternative au macronisme, à La France insoumise et au Rassemblement national.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/9fb85a8a-e4d6-11f1-8eb3-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/miniadefvillepin.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/9fb85a8a-e4d6-11f1-8eb3-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/miniadefvillepin.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">c6c746ae-e4d6-11f1-8ffb-375f4fe00708</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:42:32 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>La députée RN Laure Lavalette se défend d'être antisémite, se dédouane d'écrits vieux de "30 ans"</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261120-accusations-antis%C3%A9mitisme-d%C3%A9put%C3%A9e-rn-laure-lavalette-invoque-faits-vieux-de-30-ans</link><description>
Selon une enquête publiée mercredi par le média Les Jours, la députée du Rassemblement national du Var Laure Lavalette aurait présidé, lors de ses années d'études, un syndicat étudiant dont la revue publiait des écrits antisémites. L'élue a balayé les accusations dans une interview sur BFMTV, arguant de faits vieux de "30 ans".
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1684c9f4-e4bf-11f1-943c-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/000-A49893B.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1684c9f4-e4bf-11f1-943c-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/000-A49893B.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">00ba44a8-e4c1-11f1-9390-bd7bd8f937b3</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:26:06 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1684c9f4-e4bf-11f1-943c-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/000-A49893B.jpg">© Miguel Medina, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Dominique de Villepin candidat : un homme de droite populaire à gauche mais en quête d'électeurs</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261120-france-presidentielle-2027-dominique-de-villepin-homme-droite-populaire-gauche-sans-electeurs</link><description>
L'ancien Premier ministre Dominique de Villepin a officialisé vendredi sa candidature à l'élection présidentielle de 2027. L'homme du "non" de la France à la guerre en Irak en 2003 est revenu sur le devant de la scène ces dernières années pour ses prises de position sur les sujets internationaux, en particulier sur la guerre à Gaza. Mais sa popularité est surtout marquée à gauche, au sein d'un électorat qui ne devrait pas voter pour lui.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/fd73fc2c-e433-11f1-b4e5-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/main-Villepin.png"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/fd73fc2c-e433-11f1-b4e5-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/main-Villepin.png" type="image/png" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">c0ca20de-e434-11f1-a9ea-f369f859b733</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 06:43:38 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/fd73fc2c-e433-11f1-b4e5-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/main-Villepin.png">© AFP / Studio graphique, FMM</source><dc:creator>Romain BRUNET</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Yannick Jadot claque la porte des Écologistes suite au rapprochement entre Marine Tondelier et LFI</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261119-france-presidentielle-yannick-jadot-quitte-les-ecologistes-marine-tondelier-jean-luc-melenchon-glucksmann</link><description>
Les fractures deviennent apparentes chez les Écologistes, au lendemain de la main tendue de Marine Tondelier à Jean-Luc Mélenchon : Yannick Jadot, sénateur et ex-candidat écologiste à la présidentielle, a annoncé qu'il quittait le parti, tout comme le député Jérémie Iordanoff. Tous les deux préfèrent soutenir Raphaël Glucksmann.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/2434c0c2-b5b2-11ec-ac2b-005056a97e36/w:1024/p:16x9/France-Elysee2022-YannickJadot.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/2434c0c2-b5b2-11ec-ac2b-005056a97e36/w:1024/p:16x9/France-Elysee2022-YannickJadot.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">819cc766-e46d-11f1-9bfb-ffca175961e0</guid><pubDate>Thu, 19 Nov 2026 23:04:16 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/2434c0c2-b5b2-11ec-ac2b-005056a97e36/w:1024/p:16x9/France-Elysee2022-YannickJadot.jpg">© Damien Meyer, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Politique</category><title>Présidentielle 2027 : primaire de la droite et du centre, Marine Tondelier tend la main à LFI</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/politique/20261119-pr%C3%A9sidentielle-2027-primaire-de-la-droite-et-du-centre-marine-tondelier-tend-la-main-%C3%A0-lfi</link><description>
La primaire de la droite et du centre aura-t-elle lieu et qui y participera ? Une première réunion s'est tenue avec les équipes de Gabriel Attal, Bruno Retailleau et David Lisnard, mais sans Édouard Philippe, qui continue à s'y opposer. À gauche, Marine Tondelier, la patronne des Verts, fait un pas vers Jean-Luc Mélenchon pour la présidentielle, au risque de diviser son parti.

La mère d'Inass Touloub, fillette de quatre ans retrouvée morte au bord de l'A10 à l'été 1987, a été condamnée mardi 17 novembre à 20 ans de réclusion criminelle, tandis que le père écope d'une peine de 15 ans de prison pour complicité. Les deux accusés sont incarcérés immédiatement avec cette décision, rendue 39 ans après les faits et qui marque l'aboutissement d'un des plus anciens cold cases français.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/e6bb6b24-e338-11f1-9bb7-6d75ed565170/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261118-093658-093811-CS-01.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/e6bb6b24-e338-11f1-9bb7-6d75ed565170/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261118-093658-093811-CS-01.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">ec74b8e0-e338-11f1-bebb-d5605e336d9b</guid><pubDate>Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:44:55 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Mobilisations en France : la police au bord de l'épuisement professionnel</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261118-mobilisations-en-france-la-police-au-bord-de-l-%C3%A9puisement-professionnel</link><description>
Au lendemain de la mobilisation du 17 novembre, on relève que les cortèges étaient plutôt calmes : 146 000 personnes ont manifesté selon le ministère de l'Intérieur, plus de 500 000 pour la CGT. À force d’encadrer ces manifestations, des CRS se disent à bout : manque de repos, fatigue physique, prime de risque jugée insuffisante, la colère monte et le syndicat appelle à une "journée noire" le 26 novembre.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/5a810db6-e339-11f1-9fe5-ff16da94d1fe/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261118-093846-093958-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/5a810db6-e339-11f1-9fe5-ff16da94d1fe/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261118-093846-093958-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">60aeef8c-e339-11f1-b294-f99ed4307153</guid><pubDate>Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:41:43 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item></channel></rss>
